Play safely

Hideya is played on real streets. You are responsible for your own safety and for following local laws: watch for traffic, stay out of private property and closed areas, and stop playing whenever it is unsafe. Agree the play zone with everyone before a round.

Be fair and kind

Tags are confirmed in person on an honour system. Do not cheat, harass, threaten or share other players’ locations outside the game. We may remove players or accounts that break these rules.

Hosting

Joining a game is free. Hosting may require a one-time purchase, processed by Apple or Google under their terms; refunds follow their policies.

The service

Hideya is in preview and provided as it is. Location, connectivity and timing depend on your device and network, and the service may change or be unavailable. To the extent the law allows, qla.dev is not liable for loss or injury arising from playing.
